title: Equivariant pullback map on etale generator torsors
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $L$ and $f^*L=\mathcal O_Y\otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_X}f^{-1}L$ [def-pc-module-pullback] be invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let $T_L=\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_X,L)$ and $T_{f^*L}=\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_Y,f^*L)$ be their etale generator torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Let $T\prime$ be an $f^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}$-torsor and $e:f^{-1}T_L\xrightarrow{\sim}T\prime$ an isomorphism of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume that for every etale $W\to X$, unit $a\in\mathbf G_m(W)$ and generator $s\in T_L(W)$, $e(\eta_T(as))=\eta_G(a)e(\eta_T(s))$, where the two units are evaluated on $W\times_XY$. Then there is a morphism of sheaves of sets $\sigma:T\prime\to T_{f^*L}$ which is equivariant along $c_f:f^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,Y}$, the map adjoint to pullback of units: for every etale $V\to Y$, $a\in(f^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X})(V)$ and $t\in T\prime(V)$, $\sigma(at)=c_f(a)\sigma(t)$.

source.place: Tag 040E, construction of the generator torsor, and its pullback naturality (item proof step 2)

proof.text: Represent a section of the generator torsor on an etale X-scheme W by an isomorphism O_W -> L|_W. Pull it back on W times_X Y. The tensor formula sends a local generator s to 1 tensor s; compatibility of successive module pullbacks identifies this with a generator of the restriction of tensorPullback(f)(L). These maps commute with restriction because pullback is functorial.

The compatible maps on pulled-back etale objects extend to a map out of the sheafified inverse image of the sheaf of generators, by the inverse-image adjunction and sheafification universal property. Compose with the inverse of the given sheaf isomorphism eT to obtain sigma on T-prime.

For a local unit a and generator s, the tensor identity 1 tensor (a s) = c_f(a)(1 tensor s) proves equivariance on sections in the image of the set and group inverse-image units. The hypothesis on eT identifies the pulled-back action on those sections with the action of T-prime. Locally any sections of the inverse-image group and set sheaves come from these units, after a common refinement, so the identity extends to every local section; the sheaf separatedness condition gives the global equality.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_generators_pullback_equivariant
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} L]
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} ((tensorPullback f).obj L)]
    (T' : Sheaf.Torsor ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj X.gmSheaf))
    (eT : (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf ≅ T'.sheaf)
    (heT : ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : X.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op W))
        (t : (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
          eT.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W))
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f) (Type (u + 1))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
                  (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf).hom.app (op W)
                ((etaleIsoTorsor L).vadd (op W) g t)) =
          T'.vadd (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W))
            (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app
                X.gmSheaf).hom.app
              (op W) g)
            (eT.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W))
              (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f) (Type (u + 1))
                (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
                (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
                  (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf).hom.app (op W) t))) :
    ∃ σ : T'.sheaf ⟶ (etaleIsoTorsor ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).sheaf,
      ∀ (U : Y.Etaleᵒᵖ)
        (a : ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj X.gmSheaf).obj.obj U)
        (t : T'.sheaf.obj.obj U),
        σ.hom.app U (T'.vadd U a t) =
          (etaleIsoTorsor ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).vadd U
            ((upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf f).hom.app U a) (σ.hom.app U t)
